headline: Drafting the Ethics Code, carried over as unfinished business.
summary: The main business is continued work on drafting the Ethics Code. Announcements and new business are also on the agenda.

For public comment via Zoom, you will need to use the "raise your hand" feature. To raise your hand via the 
telephone, please hit *9. You will be unmuted by the host when it is time for public comment.
